name: outpost-protocol-zero
description: OUTPOST: PROTOCOL ZERO - AAA Ultra-High Performance Sci-Fi Tower Defense Game (MERN Stack)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.zip: powershell -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; if (Test-Path outpost-tower-defense.zip) { Remove-Item -Force outpost-tower-defense.zip }; if (Test-Path outpost-source) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force outpost-source }; New-Item -ItemType Directory outpost-source | Out-Null; Copy-Item package.json, README.md, NUMBERS.md, vercel.json, .gitignore outpost-source\; New-Item -ItemType Directory outpost-source\test, outpost-source\client, outpost-source\server | Out-Null; Copy-Item test\* outpost-source\test\; Copy-Item -Recurse client\src, client\public, client\dist, client\index.html, client\package.json, client\vite.config.js, client\postcss.config.js, client\tailwind.config.js, client\.gitignore outpost-source\client\; Copy-Item -Recurse server\config, server\controllers, server\models, server\routes, server\server.js, server\package.json outpost-source\server\; [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::CreateFromDirectory((Resolve-Path outpost-source), (Join-Path (Get-Location) 'outpost-tower-defense.zip')); Remove-Item -Recurse -Force outpost-source"

author: Antigravity Engineering
